data.description:
## Failure Signature

- Test names: 8 tests in `tests/test_implement_drive.py` (drive `phase_drive` unit tests)
- Failing commit: (driven-worktree run; latent since SA-0MUWNHKQH0034DW9)

## Root Cause

`skill/implement/scripts/implement.py` exports `IMPLEMENT_DRIVE_ACTIVE=1` into
each driven child session (recursion guard, `phase_drive` refuses to re-enter
drive). That guard is read from `os.environ` at call time. The
`tests/test_implement_drive.py` unit tests exercise `phase_drive` **in-process**
under whatever ambient environment pytest inherits — including, when the full
suite runs inside a driven child session (as `implement.py finish` does), the
inherited `IMPLEMENT_DRIVE_ACTIVE=1`. The recursion guard then fires in every
drive test that does not itself set the variable, failing the run with
"Refusing to drive from within a driven child session
(IMPLEMENT_DRIVE_ACTIVE=1)". Observed during the SA-0MV8311B3005DNG8 epic:
`rc=0` changed-scope but the full-suite gate failed on 8 drive-test failures.

## Scope

- Make `tests/test_implement_drive.py` hermetic against the ambient
  `IMPLEMENT_DRIVE_ACTIVE` env var so the full suite passes when run from a
  driven session (required for any epic child's `implement.py finish` gate and
  the pre-push hook).
- The recursion-guard unit test itself (`test_recursion_guard_refuses_from_driven_session`)
  must still pass (it sets the variable explicitly).

## Acceptance Criteria

- **Hermetic tests:** with `IMPLEMENT_DRIVE_ACTIVE=1` present in the
  environment, all 8 previously-failing `tests/test_implement_drive.py` tests
  pass together with the file's other tests.
- **Guard still enforced:** `test_recursion_guard_refuses_from_driven_session`
  still passes (explicit variable set) — the production recursion guard is
  unchanged.
- **No production behaviour change:** `phase_drive`/`_child_session_env` in
  `skill/implement/scripts/implement.py` are not modified.
- **Full project test suite passes** with the change (no regressions).

## Key Files

- `tests/test_implement_drive.py` — the fix (test-side hermeticity).

## Related Work

- Parent epic SA-0MV8311B3005DNG8 (live-repo guard). Discovered while driving
  child SA-0MV87FGCP00865QF.
- Drive feature SA-0MUWNHKQH0034DW9 (latent source of the env export).

## Notes

No live checkout is mutated. No production code is changed. The fix is a test
fixture/`delenv` that isolates the drive tests from the ambient guard variable.
